RESULT: Issue 1: Snapshot observation eligibility granted and consumable despite invalid base FK. File/lines: tools/testing/xiangqi_tracking/scene_state.py#L153-L157 and tools/testing/xiangqi_tracking/stable_observation.py#L263-L274, L356-L359, L385-L389. Triggering sequence: A locked snapshot exists (StableObservation.snapshot is set, self.requested is False). A camera frame arrives where camera geometry matches snapshot targets (_scene_matches is True) and feedback is stationary (safe is True), but BaseGeometry forward kinematics fails (transform is None, base_valid is False, record['base_transform_valid'] is False). SceneState.process invokes self.observation.observe(record, now, safe, ...) passing safe=True without gating on base_valid. In StableObservation.observe, line 265 sets self.pending = not matches or not trusted (evaluating to False) without checking record.get('base_transform_valid'). Consequently, status(now)['observation_eligible'] returns True, allowing action='consume' in StableObservation.request to vend a base-coordinate snapshot while base FK is invalid.

Issue 2: Expired/out-of-order controller feedback packets resurrect retired controller epochs. File/lines: tools/testing/xiangqi_tracking/stable_observation.py#L70-L83 (FeedbackWindow.ingest). Triggering sequence: FeedbackWindow is tracking active epoch E2 with self.last=t2. A delayed/reordered feedback message arrives with an older, retired epoch E1 (ingest(t1, arm, joint, now, epoch=E1)). Line 71 does not discard it because epoch == self.epoch is False. Line 79 checks epoch != self.epoch, executes self._break(), clears self.rows, and resets self.last=0. Line 82 overwrites self.epoch=E1. Because self.last was cleared to 0, line 83 (t <= self.last) does not reject the packet, allowing an expired feedback frame to reset settling and revive a retired controller epoch without epoch monotonicity or retired-epoch checks.

Issue 3: Early exit in validate() bypasses finite-value and bounded-payload enforcement when detection_valid is False. File/lines: tools/testing/xiangqi_tracking/measurement_contract.py#L120-L123, L163, and L34-L41. Triggering sequence: A camera measurement packet is provided with detection_valid=False (e.g. perception configuration change or camera detection failure) containing non-finite floats (NaN/Inf in metadata or compute dicts) or a payload size exceeding MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES. Line 120 detects not packet['detection_valid'] and line 123 executes 'return packet' early, skipping encode(packet) at line 163. The packet bypasses json.dumps(..., allow_nan=False) and payload size bounding in encode(), violating the bounded/finite wire contract and triggering an unhandled ValueError in downstream SceneState.process (line 88).
EVIDENCE: scene_state.py#L108-L109 calculates base_valid = bool(transform is not None and packet['detection_valid']). L154 passes safe (only feedback-derived) to observe(), omitting base_valid.
